mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary conditions, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4%, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, which may lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate and federal funds rate increase simultaneously, it indicates a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS increase, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods during a monetary tightening cycle, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE is below 4%, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates supply chain disruptions or reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO decreases by >0.5pp, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth slows while inflation (CPI) remains high, it indicates stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < CPIAUCSL inflation rate
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when GDPC1 growth < CPIAUCSL inflation, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts indicates reduced consumer demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when HOUST decreases by >5%, this hypothesis is falsified.
